title: Para Bellum content: economy
description: The economy's standing figures. File: Content/<namespace>/economy.json, exactly ONE across every namespace: the game refuses a second copy and refuses a content set with none. A mod cannot override this file (a recorded limitation). Of AD-M24's four terms, trade balance has no figure here: it is a declared zero until a trade system exists to write it. Unit costs, training days and speeds are NOT here: they are properties of a unit and live on its template row. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

upkeep_money_per_unit_per_month.description: Money each unit costs per month to keep.

prices.description: Money per unit of each resource pool, for the extraction term. Keyed by pool; money and manpower are not priced. Every pool something produces has a price.

commerce_money_per_thousand_people.description: Monthly economic activity per thousand civilians, for the commerce term.

industry_money_per_ic.description: Monthly economic activity from one IC on the civilian claim, for the industry term.

modernisation_per_mille.description: The standing claim off the top of every claim except construction, per mille.

industry_point.description: One point of a province's industry: 1 IC by definition, built at province level with no hex, slot or tier.

cost.description: What building one point costs, keyed by pool.

build_work_ic_days.description: The work in building one point, in IC-days.

workers.description: People one point needs. A point short of them is idle and adds nothing. At least 1, because 0 would make industry impossible to unman.

dispersed_yield_per_hex.description: Monthly yield of each resource-bearing hex, keyed by pool. The steel entry is unreachable since steel deposits retired into mills; it is kept rather than deleted, and deleting it is a separate decision.

seed_months.description: How many months of income each nation's pools start with.
